profile.py.custody: Exact bytes reconstructed from the current helper by removing only the later supplementary-dimension verifier arguments and the later explicit DEBUGINFOD_URLS environment block; the resulting bytes match the before-freeze bound hash.

driver_changes.reason: Profile reports intentionally use 8 measured samples and 1 warmup, while formal reports use 30 measured samples and 3 warmups. The verifier now accepts explicit expected_samples and expected_warmup values for supplementary profiles; the original frozen verifier is retained at interrupted/profile-attempt-2/verify-report-before-dimension-fix.py.

The profile driver now clears DEBUGINFOD_URLS in its child environment so perf report cannot block on a remote symbol server. The before profiles were invoked with DEBUGINFOD_URLS='' already; this current driver change makes that property explicit for after.

first_attempt.observed: perf record completed and the raw perf.data was retained; perf report then slept waiting for remote symbol lookup and was terminated as an owned export subprocess.

same_data_recovery.result: The same attempt-1 perf.data was exported locally after the remote report subprocess was terminated.

profile_rerun_after_recovery.result: The profile driver reran both perf stat and perf record for the owned lane with local symbol lookup. Report export completed, then the old formal verifier rejected the intentional 8/1 supplementary profile dimensions. That receipt and the pre-dimension-fix verifier are retained.

source_edit_boundary: The formal before reports and the successful before profiles were captured before the candidate production edit. This manifest records driver provenance only; it does not replace the historical before freeze or assert current source equality.
